fields.name: Vanilla Strawberry Cloud
fields.description: Light vanilla chiffon layers filled with whipped mascarpone cream and fresh seasonal strawberries. Elegant and refreshing.

fields.name: Chocolate Ganache Dream
fields.description: Triple-layered dark chocolate sponge with silky ganache filling and hand-tempered chocolate shards on top. A crowd favourite for any celebration.

fields.name: Classic Victoria Sponge
fields.description: Traditional buttery sponge with house-made strawberry jam and thick clotted cream. Simple, timeless, delicious.

fields.name: Tropical Fruit Layer
fields.description: A celebration of local Mauritian flavours � passion fruit curd, mango compote, and coconut cream between golden sponge layers.

fields.name: Floral Garden Cake
fields.description: Semi-naked cake adorned with cascading edible flowers, fresh fruit, and a honey-rose buttercream filling.

fields.name: Three-Tier Celebration
fields.description: A beautiful three-tier celebration cake decorated with fresh strawberries, delicate pink flowers, and elegant white frosting, perfect for weddings and special occasions.
